title: Affine-chart criterion for stalk normalization etaleness
statement: For the finite normalization morphism obtained from the data of `lem-sbc-stalk-normalization-etale`, every affine chart map on the stalk base has an etale ring homomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0EYJ (pione-lemma-extend-covering), proof of local claim: split-section trait test and formal section computation for etaleness

proof.text: On the original open C_U, pull back f along its open inclusion. The pullback is the finite etale map P to C_U. An integral morphism has invertible toNormalization; smooth base change along the open inclusion identifies the two normalizations. Transporting etaleness through these isomorphisms proves that f.fromNormalization restricted to C_U is etale. This is the proved local helper normalization_etale_restrict using Mathlib Normalization.

Apply the section-neighbourhood theorem to the assumed finite local normalization. Form the local section tau by pullback.lift of a followed by sigma and the identity. Its closed-point image belongs to the etale open W.

The equation sigma followed by c equals the identity gives tau followed by l followed by c equals a. The closed point of Spec O(S,s) maps to s, so W meets the missing fibre. Combine this witness, etaleness on C_U, and finiteness with fibre purity to prove etaleness everywhere.
Use the resulting Etale structure to obtain etaleness of each affine-chart appLE ring map via Etale.etale_appLE.

proof_origin.note: The assembly is proved in Lean. The section calculation and propagation across the special fibre are separate strictly smaller statements; etaleness on the original open is proved directly from Mathlib normalization.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_etale_local_charts {S C : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) (hZ : ∃ z : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Z.P, z ≫ Z.π = sη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    IsFinite (pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s))) →
    ∀ {V : (pullback c (S.fromSpecStalk s)).Opens} (_ : IsAffineOpen V)
      {W : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
        (pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s))).Opens} (_ : IsAffineOpen W)
      (e : W ≤ (pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
        (pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s))) ⁻¹ᵁ V),
      ((pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
        (pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s))).appLE V W e).hom.Etale
